summary.intent: Fix a race condition in the FUSE mount folder rename flow where the FUSE mount's pending IPNS publish could overwrite the SDK's renamed metadata, and land the fix in a clean PR against main.
summary.outcome: A clean branch `fix/fuse-folder-rename-ci` was created from main containing only the CI test timing fix commit, with the FUSE rename race condition fix already squash-merged into main via PR #466.

repo: PR #466 was squash-merged into main, which collapses individual commits into one — branching from the pre-merge feature branch and opening a new PR will include all original commits as 'unmerged' from git's perspective.
The repo is FSM1/cipher-box on GitHub.
The CI test timing fix lives in tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/test-cross-client-sync.sh and was the only delta not captured by the squash merge.

code.finding: Contains CI test timing adjustments that were committed after the squash merge of PR #466 and needed to be carried forward separately.

workflow: When a feature branch is squash-merged and you need to open a follow-up PR, always create the new branch from main (not the old feature branch) and cherry-pick or re-apply only the new commits.
Rebase onto a squash-merge target is error-prone because the squashed commit doesn't share history with the original individual commits — cleaner to diff against main and apply the delta directly.
Background bash tasks via TaskCreate can race with foreground calls; a failed task notification doesn't necessarily mean the operation failed — verify the actual state independently.

friction: Initial push went to an already-merged branch, requiring a new branch to be created.
PR #468 initially included all commits from the old feature branch because the new branch was forked from the pre-squash-merge feature branch rather than from main.
Rebase onto main hit conflicts due to squash-merge history divergence, requiring abort and a manual diff-based approach.
A stale rebase lock file had to be cleaned up before the rebase could be retried.
A background TaskCreate job reported failure (exit code 128) even though the foreground push had already succeeded, causing a confusing notification.
open_items: PR #468 was created but the transcript ends before confirming it contains only the intended CI timing fix commit — should verify the PR diff is clean before merging.

The FUSE rename race condition fix (SDK rename retry loop waiting up to 120s for IPNS metadata) landed in PR #466 but the retry loop timeout value (120s) may warrant revisiting based on real-world IPNS propagation latency.
